# End of Day: Shifts, Floats and Reports

# Point of Sale: End of Day: Shifts, Floats and Reports

The till keeps a running **shift** for each cash drawer. A shift starts with an opening float, records every payment and cash movement, and ends with a cash count and a **Z report**. Your end-of-day settings decide how that close works.

---

## End-of-day settings

In OrderHub, go to **Settings** → **POS** tab → **End of Day**.

![End of Day](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/879dbfcd-9268-4e99-be52-8d433bdab959.png)

| Setting | What it does |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Mode** | **Consolidated — one location-level close (recommended)**: a manager closes the whole location's day in one go. **Per-terminal — each device closes its own session**: each till closes its own shift. |
| **Variance threshold** | If the counted cash differs from the expected cash by more than this amount, a manager PIN is needed to finish the close. Set it to 0 to allow any difference without a manager PIN. |
| **Blind close — hide expected cash from staff during count** | Staff count the drawer without seeing what it should contain. The difference is shown after they submit. |
| **Require manager sign-off — show approval hint preemptively** | Tells staff up front that a manager will approve the close. |
| **Z report email** | Enter **Recipients (comma-separated)** to receive the Z report by email whenever a close is finalised, and an optional **Subject**. |
| **Z report auto-print** | Choose a **Printer** to print the Z report automatically when each close is finalised. |

* Note: **Cash drawers** are chosen for each till under **Edit POS Terminal** → **Cash Drawer**. Tills that share a drawer share one shift and one close.

---

## Opening a shift

Nobody can sell until a shift is open. At the start of the day, the first person to sign in sees **Open shift**:

1. Count the cash in the drawer.
2. Enter it as the **Opening float**, or use **Or count by denomination (optional)**.
3. Tap **Open shift**.

![Open Shift](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/535630e1-ce6a-416a-827b-d5beae5fcce3.png)

* Note: If yesterday's shift was never closed, the till closes it automatically, flags it for a manager to review, and asks you to count what's actually in the drawer.

---

## During the day

* The top bar shows **Session open**, the cash expected in the drawer, and when the shift started.
* Tapping it opens the **X report**: takings so far by payment method, cash movements, and the expected cash. **Only managers can view it.**
* From the X report, use **Cash movement (Pay-in / Pay-out / Drop)** to record cash added to or taken from the drawer, e.g. petty cash or a bank drop.

![Close Shift](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/3f2d8975-ffc4-4027-b7ef-d8defa66949b.png)

---

## Closing the day

A manager closes from the X report.

**Consolidated mode: Close day**

1. Tap **Close day**, then **Start close**. Any open shifts at the location are included.
2. Count the cash **Per drawer** or **Combined**, and enter the total.
3. If the difference is within your **Variance threshold**, review and finalise. If it's over, a manager approves with their PIN.
4. When the screen shows **Day closed**, the Z report is emailed and/or printed according to your settings.

**Per-terminal mode: Close shift**

1. Tap **Close shift**.
2. Enter the **Counted cash** (or count by denomination) and any **Notes**, then **Submit count**.
3. Check the difference and tap **Finalise close**. If it's over the threshold, tap **Get manager PIN**.
4. At **Session closed**, tap **Print Z report** if you want a paper copy.

![Close Shift Exception](https://nazkcvruighrhpgcarxg.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/help-documentation-images/74b59c05-fb64-4bb5-8933-776b3a356603.png)

---

## Looking back

**View closes history →** on the X report lists past closes, most recent first. Open one to see its cash count, takings by payment method and any notes. Managers can add a note with **Add finalisation note**.

---

## Good to know

* Card payments taken on a linked card reader and on-account sales appear on the reports, but they aren't counted as cash in the drawer.
* Payments recorded with an **Offline Merchant** method appear as card takings taken outside the till.
* Refunds made in cash reduce the expected cash. Card refunds don't.
